title: Bold & Savory Steak Spice Blend
description: From the r/hellofresh DIY spice blend master list, scaled so one batch (about 3 tsp) replaces one sachet. Original ratio: 4 chilli flakes, 1 coriander seeds, 2 dill seeds, 3 mustard seeds, 4 dried minced garlic, 4 black pepper, 3 salt. The post suggests 4 parts chilli flakes for heat, or 1 part for a milder blend.
aliases: Bold and Savory Steak Spice Blend

steps.text: Mix everything in a small bowl. Use the whole batch wherever a recipe calls for 1 sachet.
To keep a jar: multiply every amount by the same number (e.g. ×8 fills a small spice jar).
